about_the_game:
Welcome to the ultimate supermarket experience!
In Supermarket Simulator, you’ll step into the shoes of a store manager and run your very own bustling supermarket. From stocking shelves to managing employees, keeping customers happy, and expanding your business—everything is in your hands.

Build Your Supermarket Empire
Start small with a humble grocery store and grow it into a thriving retail empire. Design and customize your store layout, optimize product placement, and create the perfect shopping environment for your customers. The more you succeed, the more you can expand, buying new departments, special offers, and promotions to attract even more shoppers.

Strategic Management
The key to success lies in balancing supply and demand. Keep an eye on inventory levels, track sales trends, and make sure your store never runs out of popular items. Hire and manage staff, improve efficiency, and make strategic decisions to maximize your profits. Watch out for fluctuating prices, and don’t forget to compete with rival supermarkets!

Customer Satisfaction Is Everything
Your customers have specific needs and preferences. Some like the finest gourmet products, while others want quick, low-cost items. Satisfy their needs by offering a diverse range of products, running special promotions, and providing excellent customer service. Build your reputation as the go-to store in town and keep your customers coming back for more!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Core i3 / Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 / AMD RX 460
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Core i7 / Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 / AMD RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: Manage your own supermarket, from stocking shelves to handling customers. Build, upgrade, and expand your store while making strategic decisions to keep customers happy and your business booming. Can you become the ultimate supermarket tycoon?
supported_languages: English, Dutch, Turkish, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Spanish - Latin America, Bulgarian, Danish, Finnish, Hungarian, Norwegian, Portuguese - Brazil, Romanian, Swedish, Ukrainian
